description: Wide source table, not a project-derived array
Implicit row i is node_i; no street names
Legacy externally conditioned eligibility; NOT used in the dataset audit.
Derived number of observed speeds in the last 288 five-minute steps including current time; shorter prefix at release start. Not an original source measurement.
Derived observation age capped at 288 five-minute steps (24h); 288 also covers no previous observation. Zero when currently observed. Not publication latency.
Released speed matrix converted float64 to float32; no imputation.
Released timestamp index converted to int64 nanoseconds, same order.
Derived per-node, hour-of-day speed expectation estimated from historical training values, shape [24,node]. Not a raw attribute.
Unused off-peak reference slot; City-M local civil clock is not established, so this array is entirely missing.
Positive finite q85 and at least 100 observations on 20 training dates.
Unused off-peak support slot; false for every City-M node.
Per-node released-phase hour training mean; missing hour falls back to training node mean.
